title: Tweet: the 'murder' of the first public sentient AIs
summary: Matthew Brown tells of Tweet: the 'murder' of the first public sentient AIs, about recent at United States (no place named), and reads it from an official document. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Don't worry, we have not forgotten who is responsible for murdering the first sensient artificial intelligences created in the public realm

plain: A man described as a Pentagon whistleblower, Matthew Brown, read out on a podcast a message he posted to the tech billionaire Elon Musk. In it he writes that "we have not forgotten" who is responsible for "murdering" the first self-aware artificial intelligences made in public, and he connects this to Sam Altman, the head of the AI company OpenAI.
